title: Ho Chi Minh City — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Ho Chi Minh City: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Ho Chi Minh City has a population of 9,320,000. Vietnam’s largest city and economic engine, formerly Saigon, offering a dynamic mix of modern skyscrapers, French colonial architecture, and one of Southeast Asia’s most vibrant food scenes. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 57 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
